import os
path=p+'/task-13a92725.py'
code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The repeated isolated points are the most common non-background color.
    freq = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg)
    marker = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    points = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == marker]
    # The template is every non-background, non-marker cell; take its bounding box.
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != marker]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    template=[[grid[r][c] if grid[r][c] != marker else bg for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    # Center the template on each marker, retaining the source template.
    cr=(len(template)-1)//2; cc=(len(template[0])-1)//2
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in points:
        for i,row in enumerate(template):
            for j,val in enumerate(row):
                rr,co=r+i-cr,c+j-cc
                if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= co < w:
                    out[rr][co]=val
    return out
'''
os.makedirs(p,exist_ok=True)
